subject: You've been invited
heading: You've been invited
body: Hi {{name}}, an admin has created an account for you. Choose your password to finish setting it up. This also confirms your email address, so you can sign in right after.
expiryNote: This link works once and expires in {{days}} days. If it has expired, ask your admin to resend the invite, or use "Forgot password?" on the sign-in page.
ignoreFooter: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.
